| awards = }} '''Nemanja Bjelica''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: Немања Бјелица; born May 9, 1988 in [[Belgrade]], [[Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia|SFR Yugoslavia]]) is a [[Serbs|Serbian]] professional [[basketball player]]. He is a 2.09 m (6 ft 10¼ in) tall [[small forward]]-[[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and he can also play as a [[point guard]]. Currently, Bjelica is expected to be a mid-first round pick in the upcoming 2010 NBA Draft.[http://www.spoonhoops.com/2010-Mock-Draft.php] spoonhoops.com ==Pro career== Bjelica began his professional career with the [[Arkadia Traiskirchen Lions]] in the [[Österreichische Basketball Bundesliga|Austrian League]] in the 2007-08 season. He moved to the [[Naša Sinalko Liga|Serbian League]] club [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]] in 2008. ===Player profile=== Although 2.09 tall, Bjelica is a shooter and small forward - ''small'' perhaps being a contradiction in terms but his place is on the wing. He could be the surprise package after being given a real opportunity and some huge responsibility by the experienced Svetislav Pesic in what has been a breakthrough season (2008-09 season) at [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]]. Really lit it up in [[ULEB_Eurocup|Eurocup]] with some superb outside shooting while also played a big role in the Serbian play-offs as Red Star took favourites Partizan down to the wire. Averaged 7 points per game in the University Games this year and while this tournament might just come a little too quickly for him, he is now on the radar. Good with the ball in his hands and athletic, he can be a big player for Serbia in years to come. Quite whether Dusan Ivkovic sees the same promise and has the same trust as his fellow coaching legend Pesic remains to be seen. He also says that he is big fan of Partizan Belgrade and he is sure that one day he will be playing for Partizan. ==Serbian national team== {{MedalTableTop}} {{MedalCountry|{{SRB}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[EuroBasket|FIBA European Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver| [[Eurobasket 2009|2009 Poland]] | [[Serbia national basketball team|National Team]]}} {{MedalBottom}} Bjelica played with the senior [[Serbian national basketball team]] at the [[EuroBasket 2009]], where he won the silver medal. ==References== {{reflist}} == External links == *[http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/ulebcup/home/on-court/players/showplayer?pcode=001413 Euroleague.net Profile] *[http://www.eurobasket2009.org/en/cid_toT,ovGDH2EaLKL67XnPo2.playerID_61824.compID_qMRZdYCZI6EoANOrUf9le2.season_2009.roundID_6328.teamID_96799.html EuroBasket Profile] *[http://www.adriaticbasket.com/player.php?id=1028 Adriatic League Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Nemanja-Bjelica-5510/ Draftexpress.com Profile] *[http://www.basketpedya.com/Acc002InfJug.php?idjug=79412 Basketpedya.com Profile] *[http://www.nbadraft.net/players/nemanja-bjelica NBADraft.net Profile] {{Serbia Squad EuroBasket 2009}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bjelica, Nemanja}} *[http://spoonhoops.com/2010-NBA-Mock-Draft.php] [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Belgrade]] [[Category:Serbian basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] {{Serbia-basketball-bio-stub}} [[hr:Nemanja Bjelica]] [[it:Nemanja Bjelica]] [[sr:Немања Бјелица]]
